name: Sonic Princess
original_name: ソニック・プリンセス
source:
During nighttime, the terrain of the Earth is susceptible to inexplicable changes. Human beings called these strange occurrences the Phantom Phenomenon. Soon, with the power of technology and magic, they learned that threat is lurking in the depths of our planet. The underground city Ge-Pang was built to avert it. One day, a SOS alarm sounds in the city. Leila Reifido, who possesses the magical power of levitation as well as technological skills, sets out to counter an unprecedented robotic assault.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/sonic-princess]Mobygames[/url]]
translation:
每当夜幕降临，地表地形便可能发生无法解释的变化。人类把这种怪异现象称作“幻影现象”。不久，人们借助科技与魔法得知，威胁潜伏在行星深处。为抵御威胁，地下都市Ge-Pang应运而生。某天，都市响起求救警报。兼具悬浮魔力与技术才能的蕾拉·雷菲尔德出发迎击一场前所未有的机器人攻势。

[译自 [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/sonic-princess]MobyGames[/url]]
